posts.text:
Russia demands Finland leave NATO and the alliance abandon bases in the Baltic states

These “conditions” were put forward by the Russian delegation during recent trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi, BILD reports.

Moscow proposes keeping occupied Ukrainian territories and taking all of Donbas, including Kyiv-controlled parts of Donetsk and Luhansk. 

The plan also requires NATO to drop military bases in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, and Finland to leave the military alliance.

Ukraine would get non-aligned status and renounce NATO membership, though EU membership is not ruled out. Odesa and Mykolaiv ports would be demilitarized. Agreements on free navigation in the Black and Baltic Seas are also envisaged.

Russia also wants Moldova turned into a federal republic including Moldova, Gagauzia and Transnistria. If Moldova joins the EU, Transnistria and Gagauzia could hold independence referendums.

In exchange, Moscow offers to withdraw nuclear weapons from Belarus, abandon intermediate-range missiles there, and pull troops from Transnistria.

BREAKING: Three months ago, Jensen Huang belittled Colette Kress in front of senior executives, calling her “a deer in the headlights.” Now she’s replacing him as Nvidia CEO.

Kress had pushed back on those deals, questioning how to value the guarantees and measure their returns. Earlier this year she also scaled back Nvidia’s commitment to OpenAI’s Ohio data center project, from about $250 billion in credit discussed to $105 billion.

Kress, who has been at Nvidia for more than 13 years, is now interim CEO. “I believe deeply in this company and in its future,” she wrote to staff.
